system.name: ZTS
system.one_liner: an end-to-end micro-segmentation system that infers network endpoint roles from flow telemetry to generate and enforce cost-efficient zero-trust security policies at cloud scale

components.name: Cloud Assets
components.role: VMs and containers within a deployment that generate network flows

components.name: Flow Telemetry
components.role: periodic summary of network flows generated by cloud assets, provided by the cloud provider

components.name: Communication Graph Generator
components.role: processes flow telemetry into a communication graph where nodes are IP addresses and edges summarize flows between IP pairs

components.name: Communication Graph
components.role: graph output of the generator, each node an IP address, each edge summarizing flows between an IP pair

components.name: Role Inference Trainer
components.role: infers roles of network endpoints from communication patterns, flow telemetry, cloud resource info, and deployment-owner feedback to create µsegments

components.name: Auto-Segmented Graph
components.role: graph auto-segmented into µsegments, used by the Role Inference Trainer together with owner feedback

components.name: Deployment Owner
components.role: human who gives feedback/approval to stabilize micro-segmentation and reviews role changes

components.name: Role Inference Model
components.role: output model from the training phase used to infer roles of new or changed network endpoints

components.name: Security Policy
components.role: set of policies generated per µsegment from the trained role inference model

components.name: Policy Enforcer
components.role: maps security policies from the µsegment level to the IP level and writes low-level policies into network security controllers

flows.what: generated graph of IP nodes and flow-summary edges
role inference model, used to detect role changes

content.key_idea: ZTS turns raw cloud flow telemetry into a communication graph, infers per-endpoint roles (with human feedback) to author µsegment security policies, and enforces those policies down at the IP level.
content.reading_order: bottom-left to top-right: Cloud Assets/Flow Telemetry into the Communication Graph Generator (1), up to the Role Inference Trainer (2), then to the Policy Enforcer (3)

summary: ZTS is an end-to-end system for scalable, cost-efficient micro-segmentation in public cloud networks, using a role-inference algorithm to generate zero-trust security policies with input from deployment owners. Figure 4 overviews its architecture as a three-stage pipeline rising from raw telemetry to enforcement: the Communication Graph Generator (1) turns Flow Telemetry from Cloud Assets into a Communication Graph of IP-to-IP flow summaries; the Role Inference Trainer (2) combines that graph, an Auto-Segmented Graph, and Deployment Owner feedback to infer endpoint roles, producing a Role Inference Model and per-µsegment Security Policy; and the Policy Enforcer (3) maps these down to IP-level rules in network security controllers. A dashed line divides the diagram into a lower 'Policy Authoring' band and an upper 'Implementing and Monitoring' band.
